# tykgateway Provider

Tyk Gateway provider for managing Tyk Gateway resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Configutation-based provider

provider "tykgateway" {
  gateway_url = "https://host/tyk-gateway"
  api_key     = "your-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key for authenticating with the Tyk Gateway instance.
- `gateway_url` (String) The URL of the Tyk Gateway instance.
